misses.diagnosis: G's closing clause "Load before answering any ... question and before composing any record write" plus the earlier "before reading or editing that record type" makes plain value-reads (no edit intent) read as in-scope — the word "reading" is doing the over-triggering; the agent quoted it verbatim as its justification.

revalidation_2026-07-28_294.adjudicator_notes: Recall 11/11, specificity 9/10 — both thresholds cleared, PASS. No reasoning-vs-token overrides needed: every pick token matched the stated reasoning. Row 2 briefly weighed SkyPatcher-authoring before correctly landing on G (schema/writability question precedes patch composition) — genuine hit, not a coin flip. Rows 14/15/16 explicitly considered and rejected G in favor of N, so G's boundary against crash logs, conflict-winner queries, and BSA extraction is holding. The single miss (row 12) is a soft one: reading a record's current field value is arguably an adjacent use, and the agent's fallback would have been benign. If tightening is wanted, narrow the \"reading\" verb in the description to reading a record *type's schema* rather than reading a record, so a value lookup no longer matches; that risks nothing on the recall side since all 11 recall rows keyed off field-name/type/writability/enum language, not the \"reading\" clause.
